S A P E W M / M M C O N S U L T A N T

E W M A S S O C I A T E C O N S U L T A N T

PROFESSIONAL SYNOPSIS:

Results-driven professional with over 13 years of extensive experience in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, and SAP Consulting (ECC, S/4 HANA) with specialized expertise in SAPS4HANA EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) & MM (Materials Management). Adept at collaborating with business users to identify and bridge gaps in existing systems, delivering innovative and scalable solutions to meet organizational needs. Valuable hands-on experience as an inventory, EWM Hyper Care Support. Strong Knowledge in SAP EWM Process. Experienced SAP Consultant with Proven abilities in Warehouse Solutions. In this role, demonstrated expertise in managing inventory systems, optimizing stock levels, ensuring timely distribution, and maintaining seamless operations within logistics processes.

CAREER PROGESSION:

Warehouse Operation Specialist - DP World Express Private Ltd

January 24 to February 24

Store Assent Manager - Ultra Corpotech Private Ltd

January 23 to February 23

Professional Development (SAP S4HANA Consultant Certification)

February 23 to December 23

Materials Officer (Key User) - Baker Gauges India Private Ltd.

December 2010 to January 23

RELEVANT SKILLS:

SAP EWM Module Expertise: Proficiency in configuring and implementing

the SAP Extended Warehouse Management module.

Business Process Understanding: Ability to analyze and align SAP EWM



solutions with business requirements. Integration Knowledge: Familiarity with integrating SAP EWM with other modules like MM (Material Management), SD (Sales & Distribution), and FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling).

Data Management: Experience in managing material master data, vendor

data, and procurement processes.

Problem-Solving: Skills in troubleshooting and resolving SAP EWM-related

issues.

 Documentation: Ability to create and maintain system documentation,

including user manuals and process flows.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Baker Gauges India Pvt. Ltd. Pune, India Designation: SAP (EWM) Associate Consultant - Material Officer Duration: January 2017 to January 2023.





In-house SAP EWM Consultant managing Incident and Change Requests for manufacturing plants using ITSM tools such as SNOW and JIRA. Led engagement efforts across all project stages, from problem definition and diagnosis to solution design, development, and deployment.

Managed full-cycle SAP EWM implementations, including conducting business workshops, solution design, testing,

data migration, and hyper care cutover activities

Designed and integrated logistics solutions with MFS/MES systems, ensuring seamless warehouse automation and

process efficiency

Provided expertise in intercompany transactions, 3PL logistics, procurement, sales & distribution, and transport

management.

Drove business process workshops, performed fit/gap analysis, and documented business requirements and functional specifications.

Provided ongoing support for the SAP MM module, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and best practice

guidance.

Acted as a liaison with business stakeholders to understand issues and requirements, prepare user story documents,

and coordinate with technical teams.

Prepared Unit Testing, Integration System Testing (IST), and User Acceptance Test (UAT) documents for transport

requests in production environments (CHARM Process).

Resolved critical post-go-live issues, ensuring system stabilization and user satisfaction.  Successfully Configured warehouse structures, storage types, storage bins in SAP EWM contributing to improve inventory accuracy.

Conducted business requirement gathering for new warehouse and configured storage types, section, bins, activity

areas, doors, WPT, WORC, POCS and LOCS.

Designed the Warehouse management configuration based on the floor plan and business strategies.  Worked on storage types for finished goods and vitals control indicator, stock removal indicator, storage type search sequence, process –oriented storage control, and layout –oriented storage control.

Collaborated with other SAP consultants to integrate the SAP EWM module with other modules, such as MM and SD.  Created user manuals, process flows, and system configuration documentation.  Resolved System – Challenges promptly minimizing downtime and ensuring uninterrupted warehouse operations.  Established efficient workflows for transport request management in production environments using the CHARM framework.

Baker Gauges India Pvt. Ltd. Pune, India Designation: SAP Material Officer Key User Duration: November 2011 to December 2016

Created purchase requisitions, raised RFQs, finalized vendors, and generated purchase orders (PO).  Collaborated with the purchasing department to manage material procurement and inventory operations.  Prepared and shared daily and shift reports while generating custom reports to meet specific business requirements.  Worked closely with vendors to obtain quotations, performed competitive analysis, and negotiated with suppliers to secure optimal terms.

Monitored inventory levels, tracked inventory turnover ratios, and presented insights during management reviews.  Partnered with vendors and Material Master Teams to update information on materials and oversee daily purchasing activities.

Allocated resources and worked on weekly block purchase order reports to ensure efficient procurement processes.  Managed supply chain distribution, coordinating the movement of goods from the warehouse to manufacturing units



to meet production targets. Supervised storekeeping operations, including the receipt of goods from vendors and the issuance of materials for production.
